text: 43. Jesus said, You are of your father the devil, and you want to do the desires of...

Jesus said, You are of your father the devil, and you want to do the desires of your father. He was a murderer from the beginning, and does not stand in the truth because there is no truth in him. Whenever he speaks a lie, he speaks from his own nature, for he is a liar and the father of lies. (John8:44)
